results.title: This Day in History: March 31, 1889: The Eiffel Tower opens in Paris, France
excerpts:
The Eiffel Tower officially opened on March 31, 1889 in Paris. By Live 5 Web Staff Published: Mar. 31, 2026 at 5:00 AM EDT | Updated: Mar. 31, 2026 at 6:18 AM EDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google PARIS (WCSC) — The Eiffel Tower officially opened on March 31, 1889 in Paris. The tower was designed by Gustave Eiffel and is locally nicknamed “La dame de fer,” meaning “Iron Lady.” It was constructed as the centerpiece of the 1889 World’s Fair and to mark the centennial anniversary of the French Revolution. Standing at 1,083 feet tall — roughly the height of an 81-story building — the Eiffel Tower is the tallest structure in Paris. Nothing so high had been built since the Great Pyramid ! Constructed over two years for the Exposition Universelle of 1889 and the centenary of the French Revolution , the Eiffel Tower soars up 300 metres high. And, until the inauguration of the Empire State Building in 1931, was the tallest building in the world ! Built as a technological showcase for France , the audacious and monumental tower propelled the country into modernity . Today it remains Paris’s most visited monument .
